events.did: 每次试验失败后只能回头使用 Haverty 的原始血清来稳定心脏，直到下一次尝试
events.quote_anchor: And every time the attempted progress failed, which it did, again, and again, and again, he was forced to return to the numbing poison of Haverty’s original serum

events.did: 把一支新的药筒交给 Victor，筒中的液体不再是蓝色而是紫色
events.quote_anchor: And then, one day, she handed him a fresh cartridge, the liquid inside no longer blue, but violet.

events.did: 把 Dani 的最新配方装入吸入器，Dani 同时把计时器设为五分钟
events.quote_anchor: Victor slotted her latest formula into the inhaler as Dani set the timer for five minutes.

events.did: 把吸入器举到嘴边深吸一口
events.quote_anchor: Victor lifted the inhaler to his mouth and drew in deeply.

events.did: 在疼痛如期没有出现后说出「It works」
events.quote_anchor: “It works,” he said, those two small words buzzing with power.

events.did: 睁大眼睛笑着说「I think we have a winner」
events.quote_anchor: “Holy shit,” said Dani, eyes going wide. A smile broke across her face. “I think we have a winner.”

events.did: 对闯入实验室的年轻人动用能力抓住其神经，把档位猛地调高
events.quote_anchor: Victor reached out, not with his hand, but his power, took hold of the intruder’s nerves, and snapped the dial up

events.did: 从 Victor 手里拿回吸入器并弹出药筒
events.quote_anchor: As she spoke, Dani took back the inhaler and ejected the vial.

relations.did: 与 Victor 的关系：在 Victor 头痛到看不见时仍安慰他说自己越来越接近了
relations.quote_anchor: “I’m getting closer,” she said, when the headache got so bad he couldn’t see.

relations.did: 与 Victor 的关系：坚持紫色配方只是原型，在更多测试完成前要他继续用旧配方
relations.quote_anchor: holding up the violet vial, “is a prototype, not a finished product, and until I can run more tests, I want you to keep using the old compound

relations.did: 与 Victor 的关系：冲上前质问 Victor 是否刚杀了自己的助教
relations.quote_anchor: Dani yelped. “Did you just kill my TA?” she snapped, rushing toward the body.

relations.did: 与 Dani 的关系：他接受回旧药筒，心里赞赏她的严谨
relations.quote_anchor: As Victor accepted the old cartridge, the scientific side of his mind applauded her due diligence.

numbers.quote_anchor: as Dani set the timer for five minutes. That was all the time he had these days

numbers.did: Five minutes became ten, and then fifteen（五分钟变成十分钟，再变成十五分钟）
numbers.quote_anchor: Five minutes became ten, and then fifteen, and still death showed no sign of reaching out for him.

numbers.who: Dani 估计 Victor 昏迷时间
numbers.did: eight to twelve hours（八到十二小时）
numbers.quote_anchor: My guess is anywhere from eight to twelve hours, since I modeled it on the original.

numbers.who: Victor 失去能力/濒死的时长
numbers.quote_anchor: the part that had spent nearly a decade either powerless or dying—wasn’t interested in safe.

numbers.who: Victor 说的那句话里的词数
numbers.quote_anchor: “It works,” he said, those two small words buzzing with power.
